run.note: the 3 failures are proposed vectors that wait for a change; vectors the run confirmed carry basis run

tokens.$hash:<text>: replace with Gate.simHash(<text>), in keys and values

ctxTypes.sensor: "heuristic" means (m, s) => Gate.sensorHeuristic(m, s); absent means no sensor function

categories.accept: must be admitted (or paged) as stated
categories.reject-code: must be refused, held, expired or logged with this exact reason code
categories.adversarial: a hostile sender's attempt; must be stopped with this exact code (break vectors show it getting through)
categories.known-gap: documents a check the gate does not make yet (env.state, single-use grants) or a scenario with break: null today; expected to change

defaultParams: Gate.defaults() (MEMBRANE.params); vector params, then step params, are merged over it
